verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents private sub-teams for sensitive work. It offers a 'Private to team members' option that hides the sub-team from everyone except directly invited members, plus a softer 'Restricted to parent team members' mode, which matches restricting a sub-team to specific members. Private-team visibility also carries over to initiatives those teams lead. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth docs on who can create or configure private sub-teams (role and plan requirements) beyond changelog snippets.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members

citations.quote: Private to team members — the team is hidden, except to members directly invited to that sub-team
Private sub-teams organize groups that work together under one umbrella, like independent business units, skunkworks efforts, or teams handling sensitive data
For work that requires tighter access, initiatives led by private teams are only visible to team members.
